parent_message.text: Investigating production error on checkout validation (ticket DC-8692). Empty card verification payloads currently trigger NullPointerException in PaymentValidationService and crash with HTTP 500. Proposing we reject missing card tokens with HTTP 400 Bad Request instead.

replies.text: Agreed. The legacy validation flow silently allowed empty tokens, but returning 400 with a descriptive error prevents downstream processor retries. Please make sure we log the client validation error and return the unified error payload.
Opened PR #123 with the defensive check and unit tests for DC-8692. Thanks Sam!
